lessons.title: What is sustainability?

newItems.definition: Using things in a way that does not harm the future.
The number of different plants and animals in a place.
A future with cleaner air and a healthy planet.
To live with fewer things.
A system where things are used again, not thrown away.

mainWord.definition: Using things in a way that does not harm the future.

lessons.mainWordForms: Sustainability is a noun. Using things in a way that does not harm the future. Sustainability helps our children.
lessons.expression: We can live more simply every day.
lessons.use: Use this when you talk about a simple, green life.
lessons.expressionTask: Daniel talks to Maya about sustainability. What does he do?
lessons.grammar: Cleft sentences: What we need is a greener future
lessons.pattern: What we need is a greener future.
lessons.task: What we need ___ a greener future.
lessons.example: What we need is a greener future.
context: Daniel talks to Maya about sustainability at work.
We can live more simply every day. A circular economy wastes less.
dialogue: Daniel: Maya, what is sustainability?
Maya: It means we use things with care, so the future stays green.
Daniel: I see. What is biodiversity?
Maya: Biodiversity means many kinds of plants and animals live here.
Daniel: And what is a circular economy?
Maya: In a circular economy, we use things again. We can live more simply every day.
lessons.listening: On Monday, Daniel talks to Maya about sustainability at work. He asks, 'Maya, what is sustainability?' Maya says, 'It means we use things with care, so the future stays green.' Daniel asks, 'What is biodiversity?' Maya says, 'Biodiversity means many kinds of plants and animals live here.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya.'
lessons.question: What does Daniel ask about?
lessons.reading: On Monday, Daniel talks to Maya about sustainability at work at Carter Retail Group. He asks, 'Maya, what is sustainability?' Maya says, 'Sustainability means we use things with care, so the future stays green. We can live more simply every day.' Daniel asks, 'What is biodiversity?' Maya says, 'Biodiversity means many kinds of plants and animals live in one place. A place with strong biodiversity stays healthy.' Daniel says, 'I see. What is a circular economy?' Maya says, 'In a circular economy, we use things again and again. We fix old things, we share them, and we throw away less. That helps us live more simply and it gives children a greener future.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya. I want a greener future too.' Maya says, 'Good. Start small. Live more simply every day.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Maya say about sustainability?
lessons.readingA: Use things with care, and live more simply every day.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about sustainability. What do you do to live more simply?
lessons.speakingSample: I want to tell you about sustainability. On Monday, Daniel talked about sustainability at work. He said, 'Sustainability means we use things with care, so the future stays green.' Biodiversity means many kinds of plants and animals live in one place. In a circular economy, we use things again and again. I can live more simply every day, and I want a greener future.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about sustainability. Say what you do.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about sustainability. On Monday, Daniel talked about sustainability at work. He said, 'Sustainability means we use things with care, so the future stays green.' Biodiversity means many kinds of plants and animals live in one place. In a circular economy, we use things again and again. I can live more simply every day, and I want a greener future. I hope you will join me. Please tell me about your work. Best, Daniel
lessons.sound: Sustainability has its strongest beat on NAY. In sustainability, say NAY clearly in the middle. In biodiversity, say VER clearly in the middle.
lessons.model: We need sustainability for a greener future.

lessons.title: Climate change in depth
lessons.goal: I can talk about climate change.

newItems.definition: Cutting down forests over a wide area.
A huge river of ice that moves slowly.
The work of protecting nature.
Adding no more greenhouse gas to the air than you take out.
newItems.example: The city aims for net zero by 2040.

newItems.definition: To wash with less water.

mainWord.definition: Cutting down forests over a wide area.

lessons.mainWordForms: Deforestation is a noun. Cutting down forests over a wide area. Deforestation harms the planet.
lessons.expression: The city aims for net zero by 2040.
lessons.use: Use this when you talk about a city's climate plan.

context: Priya talks to Daniel about climate change at work.
The city aims for net zero by 2040. Deforestation makes the Earth warmer.
dialogue: Priya: Daniel, why is the Earth warmer now?
Daniel: Deforestation is one big cause. We cut down too many trees.
Priya: True. What about the glacier?
Daniel: The glacier is melting fast. That is why the sea is higher.
Priya: What can we do?
Daniel: Conservation helps. We can take shorter showers and the city aims for net zero by 2040.
lessons.listening: On Tuesday, Priya talks to Daniel about climate change at work. She asks, 'Daniel, why is the Earth warmer now?' Daniel says, 'Deforestation is one big cause. We cut down too many trees.' Priya asks, 'What about the glacier?' Daniel says, 'The glacier is melting fast. That is why the sea is higher.' Daniel is happy.
lessons.question: Why is the Earth warmer?
lessons.reading: On Tuesday, Priya talks to Daniel about climate change at work at Carter Retail Group. She asks, 'Daniel, why is the Earth warmer now?' Daniel says, 'Deforestation is one big cause. We cut down too many trees, and the Earth gets warmer. That is why a glacier is melting fast. The glacier is a huge river of ice, and when it melts, the sea is higher.' Priya asks, 'What can we do?' Daniel says, 'Conservation helps a lot. We can plant trees, and we can take shorter showers to save hot water. The city aims for net zero by 2040, so it will add no more gas to the air than it takes out. If we act now, the future stays green.' Priya is happy. She says, 'Thank you, Daniel. I will take shorter showers every day.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Daniel say about climate change?
lessons.readingA: Deforestation makes the Earth warmer, but conservation helps.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about climate change. What causes it? What can we do?

We cut down too many trees, and the Earth gets warmer.' A glacier is a huge river of ice, and when it melts, the sea is higher. Conservation helps a lot. We can take shorter showers, and the city aims for net zero by 2040.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about climate change. Say what your city does.

To throw away less of what you buy.
